detail.longDescription: I'm building a website for an architecture firm. For each project, only the primary state is visible at first. On click, a variant opens and more info expands — so a kind of "accordion light". When you open one project, the ones already open don't close. The projects are reachable via scroll sections from a project list page. When I link to these from the project list (a different page), it always opens the primary (i.e., closed) state. How could I link directly to the open variant instead?
